integrity: All theorem hypotheses used by the witness are checked explicitly. The contradiction uses the strictly positive dilation parameter rho=1/10 and therefore does not rely on the separate rho=0 boundary for strict positivity of row coefficients.
scientific_limitations: The witness uses a piecewise-constant variable ordering map, which is permitted by the stated theorem. The result refutes only the necessary non-dominated multiplier statement in Theorem 4.1(a) and does not identify the weakest additional assumptions that would repair it.
title: A polar-intersection counterexample to variable-order KKT multipliers
